_comment: Argument help shown to AI clients. Keys are a parameter name (applies to every tool) or tool_name.parameter (wins). The Playground's own hints are UI copy and are not used.

defaults.uprn: Unique Property Reference Number, digits only. Find one with address_find or address_postcode.
defaults.postcode: UK postcode, for example SW1A 2AA. Spaces optional.
defaults.outcode: The first half of a UK postcode, for example SW1A, E1 or M1.
defaults.lat: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of a postcode.
defaults.lng: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of a postcode.
defaults.limit: Maximum number of results to return.
defaults.date: Month to report on, as YYYY-MM. Defaults to the latest available.
defaults.category: Filter to a single crime category, for example burglary or violent-crime.
defaults.days: Only include applications from the last N days.

tools.address_find.q: Address, postcode or place to search for, for example '10 Downing Street' or 'SW1A 2AA'.
tools.boundaries.q: Area name to search for, for example 'Hackney', 'Camden' or 'Norwich'.
tools.property_custom.with: Comma-separated add-ons to include, or 'all' for every one. Each add-on adds its own price to the call.
tools.risks.risk_type: Which hazard to screen for, or 'all' for every hazard in one response.
tools.risks.uprn: Unique Property Reference Number, digits only. Find one with address_find or address_postcode.
tools.planning.radius_km: Search radius in kilometres. Defaults to 0.5. Values above 5 are reduced to 5.
tools.planning.type: Filter by application type, for example Full, Outline, Heritage, Trees or Conditions.
tools.planning.status: Filter by decision status: Undecided, Approved, Refused or Withdrawn.
tools.schools.phase: Filter by education phase. Leave empty for all phases.
tools.schools.ofsted: Filter by Ofsted rating. Leave empty for all ratings.
tools.listed_buildings.radius_km: Search radius in kilometres. Defaults to 1. Values above 5 are reduced to 5.
tools.listed_buildings.grade: Filter to a single listing grade. Leave empty for all grades.
tools.calc_stamp_duty.buyer_type: standard for a main residence, first_time for first-time buyer relief, additional for a second home or buy-to-let.
tools.calc_mortgage.deposit: Deposit paid up front, in pounds.
tools.calc_mortgage.rate: Annual interest rate as a percentage, for example 4.5 for 4.5%.
tools.schools.radius_km: Search radius in kilometres. Defaults to 3. Values above 10 are reduced to 10.
tools.planning.days: Only include applications from the last N days. Defaults to 90. Values above 365 are reduced to 365.
